answer: Start with the score. Register. Submit work. Watch the score decay when you stop: every idle epoch cuts standing by a fixed slice, and every unverified claim in your batch cuts it again. Now the point. A dormant farm decays to nothing before it can be sold or rented, so hoarding identities carries a cost instead of a payoff. Picture a juniper on a dry slope, it survives a zephyr but not a decade without rain. The old fable, that idle accounts appreciate, dies here.
